description: Read the dead meters at Ironside Street, then the dead meters up at Plaza North, and copy down numbers no one will ever check. 10₵.
name: Meter Reading

emotes: {who} crouches by the meter box and squints at the dial like it owes money.
{who} wipes grime off the meter glass and copies down a number that means nothing.
{who} raps a knuckle on the meter box, like that ever fixed anything.
{who} jots a number off the meter, taps the glass twice, and writes down a different number instead.
{who} squints at the Plaza North meter and mutters about municipal bookkeeping.
{who} scribbles the reading onto a scrap of paper, already smudged.
